hypothesis: After R2 improves ranking vocabulary, reducing max selected requirements from 3 to 2 will lower workload while retaining at least 95% model-input recall.
acceptance: Model-input recall at least 0.95, average calls at most 1.5, false exposure at most 9, and no critical multi-requirement loss.
interpretation: Numeric gates pass, but the change drops a genuine booking requirement from a realistic multi-requirement message for only a small workload reduction. The quality/cost tradeoff is not justified.
